```esql
ROW title = to_text(["The Lord of the Rings"], { "analyzer": "english" }), author = to_text(["An unrelated writer"], { "analyzer": "english" })
| MV_EXPAND title
| MV_EXPAND author
| WHERE MATCH(title, "ring", { "analyzer": "english" }) OR MATCH(author, "ring", { "analyzer": "english" })
| HIGHLIGHT
| KEEP highlight_title, highlight_author
```
